entries.title: First Light
entries.offer: You look like someone with legs. Take these tapers. Light the lamps in the square before dark - the posts with the little glass hoods. Press B beside one. They stay lit till dawn, and the dark keeps its distance from them.
entries.complete: Look at that. Light where there was none. You have the hands for this. There is more, if you want to hear it.

stages.text: Light 3 lamps with a taper
Tell Marrow Pell in Wickering

entries.title: The Lamplighter's Debt
entries.offer: I owe the Collector. Every lamp I never lit is a pace of road I took on credit. He keeps a ledger in the Cairn of Debts, up on the moor. Light the road lamps between towns, then bring me the ledger - and we will see what I really owe.
entries.complete: The ledger. Page after page, and the last line is mine. Paid in light. Thank you, traveller. Take this - the Lamplighters give it only to those who repay what they borrow.

stages.text: Light 8 lamps on the roads between towns
Find the Cairn of Debts on the high moor
Take the Tallow Ledger from the Collector
Bring the ledger to Marrow Pell

entries.title: Kindle the Hollow
entries.offer: One lamp left. The Great Lamp in the Hollow Hall. It needs oil - three flasks, from the press in Reedholm - and a coal that has never gone out, from the thing that lives in the Hollow Roots. Do both and the country will see itself again.
entries.complete: There. Do you feel it? The country has remembered where its edges are. Thank you, and goodnight.

stages.text: Gather 3 flasks of lamp oil
Take the Hollow Ember from the Root Mother
Light the Great Lamp in the Hollow Hall

entries.title: Wolves at the Gate
entries.offer: Wolves have been picking off flocks along the north trail. Kill five and I will see you paid.
entries.complete: Five fewer. The shepherds will sleep tonight. Here - from the watch purse.

stages.text: Kill 5 wolves
Report to Captain Vey

entries.title: The Rook Captain
entries.offer: The Rooks hold a palisade camp east of the Greywood. Their captain is the head of the snake. End him and the roads will be safe.
entries.complete: His cleaver is yours by right of arms. The roads thank you.

stages.text: Defeat Captain Rook in his camp
Report to Captain Vey

entries.title: A Bridge Over the Kestrel
entries.offer: The Kestrel Bridge could be a road again. Twelve planks and four ingots of iron, and I will build it overnight.
entries.complete: There. Your bridge. Walk on it, run on it, dance on it if you must.

stages.text: Bring Brisk 12 planks and 4 iron ingots

entries.title: Thin Rows
entries.offer: My flax is thin this year and the hedge berries have all gone. Bring me six flax and five berries and I will pay in real coin.
entries.complete: That will see us through the winter. Take this, it was my mother's.

stages.text: Bring Tamsin 6 flax and 5 hedge berries

entries.title: Marsh Fever
entries.offer: Reedmint - six sprigs. The stilt-houses have fever and I am nearly out. It grows in the shallows, grey-green, along the water's edge.
entries.complete: You may have saved a child. I will remember it.

stages.text: Bring Sister Ilse 6 sprigs of reedmint

entries.title: Harrow Needs Iron
entries.offer: Eight iron ore. Pull it from the veins between the boulders on the moor. I will forge you something that rings.
entries.complete: Heavy, pure, red. Good. This is the first mail Harrow has made in a decade.

stages.text: Bring Hald 8 iron ore

entries.title: The Drowned Bell
entries.offer: The Bell Warden sleeps in the crypt under the sunken chapel. Bring me the bell. Ring it once and the drowned will rest.
entries.complete: One ring. Hear it? Deep in the marsh, something is finally quiet.

stages.text: Defeat the Bell Warden in the Drowned Chapel
Give the bell to the Sedge Hermit

entries.title: What the Stones Heard
entries.offer: The Listening Stones are open to you. Go. Descend. Read what is carved there, and bring me a rubbing of the notes.
entries.complete: A hymn that ends on a question. I do not know the answer, but I know whom to ask. Thank you, traveller.

stages.text: Find the Listening Stones on the high moor
Read the tablet beneath the stones
Show Edda the rubbing
